style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, satire, white sunlit interior
character: glossy dark red leech, thick ribbed body, no legs, round spectacles, banker's collar behind his head, tired eyes, fills two thirds of frame
props: a clear tube fixed to his tail sucker, running back to a glass jar labelled КРЕДИТ in big cyrillic capitals, filling with red as he goes; two clerk mites riding his back, one hammering a stamp, one unrolling a ledger strip; a huge steel press roller turning across the far end of the hall, a tall open window behind it
prop_continuity: the tube on his tail until the rolls at 7.6, torn off there; his body pales from dark red to grey as the jar fills; from 8.0 he is flat as a sheet of paper and alive
motion_rule: every window he surges along the flooded hall toward the lens, whole body undulating, his front sucker and mouth free and never attached to anything; new shot size every window, camera always moving
environment: a flooded bank hall, clear water over white marble, huge windows with hard midday sun, spray flying gold in the beams

audio.delivery: flat tired male voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: VY-dal, kre-DEET, te-PER, DOL-zhen, po-SLED-ney, KAP-li, KRO-vi
audio.pacing: steady natural tempo, never hurried; nothing said after 7.05
audio.lip_sync: his front sucker opens and closes on every syllable like a mouth, never a voice over
audio.sfx: water sloshing, stamp thud, rolls grinding, wind gusting

timeline.a: his front sucker slaps open at the lens, water bursting up into the sunbeam
timeline.c: big close on his mouth, push in

timeline.a: he surges at the lens down the flooded hall, the stamp mite hammering a stamp into his back
he throws his head sideways, the tube snaps taut and drags the jar skidding at the lens
timeline.c: big close on the taut tube, whip

timeline.a: he drives on toward the windows, the ledger mite unrolling a ledger strip down his flank
he rams his shoulder into the water, spray at the lens, both mites swinging out sideways still hooked
he heaves into the window light, his dark red draining to grey along his body
still surging at the lens, he lifts his grey head as the jar behind him fills
timeline.c: big close low frontal, push in

timeline.a: the grey leech surges onto the marble and is dragged head first into the turning rolls, the tube tearing off, the mites leaping clear
timeline.c: tight low frontal on the rolls, push in

timeline.a: he shoots out the far side flat as a sheet of paper, spectacles still on, alive and flapping, and rears up flat at the lens
timeline.c: big close low, whip up with him

timeline.a: the whole hall of grey leeches pours through the rolls and comes out flat, and a gust from the window whirls every flat leech in all directions out into the sunlight
timeline.c: pull back to low wide, flat leeches flying past the lens

must_appear: the tube on his tail until 7.6; the jar filling red; his body grey by 7.05; the rolls squeezing him flat at 8.0; the flat leech alive and flapping; the whole hall of leeches flying flat out the window at 9.5
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, garbled or misspelled words, any lettering other than КРЕДИТ, a static camera, a static wide with him small in frame, he stands still while speaking, his mouth or sucker attached to anything, the tube on his mouth or head, a mite on the floor before 7.05, props hovering motionless in mid-air, a leech with legs or fins, English speech, any word after 7.05, the leech dying or torn at the rolls, a leech still thick after the rolls, flat leeches dropping to the floor
